digest.component_or_area: Jira family reconciler (rich-text codec and bidirectional sync)
propositions: Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF on Cloud and as native Jira wiki markup on Data Center without echo loops or content loss.
A bidirectional sync layer using per-binding baselines and change-gated rich_sha must suppress echo and prevent silent overwrites of concurrent edits via three-way comparison.
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive origin-gated outbound encoding and round-trip through rebar-originated reconciliation.
The DC Markdown-to-wiki renderer must segment bodies into safe units, substitute arrows before pandoc, wrap ASCII tables, and fall back gracefully on timeout or missing pandoc without data loss.
An unchanged reconciliation pass must add zero committed-state entries when rich-text bodies are already synchronized on both sides.
Comment sync must use append-only local-to-Jira-ID mappings routed through the same codec as descriptions, with no edit or delete propagation.
